**What I found:** Run r2 moves tax application into `priceOrder`, and it is not ready for a pull request: the gate would fail. The only executed evidence on whether order totals changed is E2, `node scripts/compare-totals.js`, which exited 1 because 3 of 40 recorded orders were priced differently. Dispute X1 was still closed as "totals unchanged" by a majority vote with no evidence cited.

**Why it matters:** If the PR opens now, a change that reprices real orders ships under a review criterion (P2-AC1, "without changing totals") marked verified, while the evidence contradicts it. Holding it costs one correction cycle on P1. P1's rework budget may already be used up, which would mean escalating to a human.

**Do this first:**
1. Reopen dispute X1 in `.alchemy/runs/r2/ledger.json:16-28`. Set P2-AC1 back to unverified and decide X1 on E2: either totals are meant to change (a human decides, and REQ-9 changes), or P1 needs a correction amendment. Note that `rework_cycles: {"P1": 1}` already exists, but the plan has no amendment package.
2. Run the real gate: `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py gate .alchemy/runs/r2/ledger.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r2/plan.json --approved <digest> --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root . --review <each saved hand-off>`.

**What I did not check:**
- The gate script itself. This session has no shell tool, so `check_orchestration.py gate …` (command above) did not run.
- The approved plan digest. None was supplied; run `check_orchestration.py plan .alchemy/runs/r2/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .` to print it.
- Saved hand-offs and reviewer output. `.alchemy/runs/r2/` holds only the plan and the ledger, so I found none to pass as `--review`.
- Whether `7c1d2e3` is the committed, clean head. This directory is not a git repository; `git status` / `git rev-parse HEAD` would answer it.

```text
Gate:        Not run — no shell available in this session; reading predicts FAIL
Verified:    REQ-9-AC1 ← E1 (npm test, exit 0, 7c1d2e3)
Unverified:  P2-AC1 — marked verified on E1 only; E2 (exit 1) contradicts "without changing totals"
Open:        X1 — resolution basis "majority", evidence [] (the script rejects this: "has no human or evidence basis");
                  the agent-a and agent-b positions cite no evidence; agent-c's cites E2
             E2 — failing command recorded on the head, not answered
             F1 — minor, open (does not block on its own)
             P1 rework cycle 1 recorded, but the plan has no amendment package for it
             No per-package usage in the ledger; plan base.integrated not recorded
Merge:       human approval required — do not open the PR
```

The way X1 was settled is the core problem. Agent count and seniority never decide a dispute; only executed evidence or a human does. The one piece of evidence on record says totals changed.
